product_brief: Quantum-safe PKI toolkit for post-quantum cryptography with interoperable, standards-compliant certificates.
pqc_capability_description: Supports ML-DSA, SLH-DSA, and ML-KEM via Cloudflare CIRCL (FIPS 203/204/205 implementations). Features hybrid certificates (classical + PQC), composite certificates, and CSR generation for PQC algorithms. Validated with NIST ACVP test vectors.
key_management_model: CLI-first, no database required; HSM support via PKCS#11; pure Go by default (CGO optional for HSM)
fips_validated: No (uses FIPS 203/204/205 implementations from Cloudflare CIRCL and NIST ACVP test vectors, but no FIPS 140 validation stated)
pqc_roadmap_details: Supports migration between algorithms (e.g., ECDSA -> ML-DSA); supports hybrid and composite certificates for transition.
signature_schemes: ECDSA, EdDSA (Ed25519, Ed448), RSA, ML-DSA, SLH-DSA
testing_&_validation_methods: Cross-validated with external implementations (OpenSSL, BouncyCastle); NIST ACVP test vectors validated.
deployment_&_migration_complexity: CLI-first, simple, scriptable, no database required; supports crypto-agility for seamless migration.
